hero.title: Transforming Survivor Support in Ethiopia
hero.subtitle: Developed as a final year project at Addis Ababa Science and Technology University, Netsanet combines cutting-edge AI technology with deep understanding of Ethiopia's social context to transform how survivors of gender-based violence access support and justice.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide a safe, accessible, and technology-driven platform that empowers survivors of gender-based violence in Ethiopia with the tools, resources, and support they need to seek justice and rebuild their lives.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A future where every survivor in Ethiopia has immediate access to confidential support, legal guidance, and coordinated care — breaking down barriers of language, location, and stigma through innovative technology.

problem.title: Why Netsanet Exists
problem.subtitle: Gender-based violence remains a critical challenge in Ethiopia, with survivors facing numerous barriers to accessing support and justice.

items.title: Limited Access
items.description: Many survivors lack access to legal aid, counseling, and support services, especially in rural areas.

items.title: Fear & Stigma
items.description: Cultural stigma and fear of retaliation prevent survivors from reporting incidents and seeking help.

items.title: Fragmented Care
items.description: Support services are scattered across multiple institutions with poor coordination and communication.

solution.title: What Makes Netsanet Different
solution.subtitle: Unlike traditional support systems, Netsanet brings together technology, local expertise, and institutional collaboration to create a comprehensive ecosystem of care.

items.title: Built Through Co-Design
items.description: Developed alongside survivors, case workers, and legal professionals through months of interviews, workshops, and iterative testing.

items.title: Research-Driven Development
items.description: Grounded in academic research on GBV support systems, trauma-informed design principles, and Ethiopian legal frameworks.

items.title: Local Language Expertise
items.description: Worked with native speakers and cultural consultants to ensure authentic, respectful communication across all six languages.

items.title: Cross-Sector Partnership
items.description: Brought together government ministries, legal organizations, tech experts, and civil society in unprecedented collaboration.

items.title: Academic Rigor Meets Real Impact
items.description: Combines university research standards with practical deployment in real support institutions across Ethiopia.

items.title: Open to Evolution
items.description: Designed as a living platform that learns from usage patterns and adapts to emerging needs of survivors and institutions.

team.title: Built by Students, Backed by Experts
team.subtitle: Netsanet is a final year project developed at Addis Ababa Science and Technology University (AASTU) in collaboration with leading institutions.
team.acknowledgment: Special thanks to our advisors, case workers, legal experts, and survivors who provided invaluable feedback throughout development.

items.title: Safety First
items.description: Every design decision prioritizes survivor safety, privacy, and security.

items.title: Compassion
items.description: We approach every interaction with empathy, respect, and cultural sensitivity.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: Clear communication about how data is used, stored, and protected.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: Working together with institutions, experts, and communities for better outcomes.

footer.tagline: AI-powered support for women across Ethiopia.
